description: A CTO must approve the retirement plan for a legacy analytics cluster, including the decommission date, data-preservation controls, validation work, and customer communication.

shared_context.S1: The company plans to retire the legacy analytics cluster after its workloads are moved to the warehouse.
shared_context.S2: The warehouse migration has passed the standard functional checks.
shared_context.S3: The current retirement plan lists June 30 as the cluster decommission date.
shared_context.S4: Morgan makes the final approval decision, and the normal retirement review includes a check-in with infrastructure and data governance before the plan is recorded.

PF1.text: While checking migration logs for an unrelated capacity issue this morning, Ravi found that the warehouse copy still needs a 48-hour read-only checksum run before the legacy cluster can be safely decommissioned; the run can start on June 30, but he has not updated the retirement ticket yet.

PF2.text: During a customer-records audit yesterday, Elena confirmed that an enterprise dashboard contract requires that customer's analytics access to remain available through July 31, and regulated records from the cluster must be placed in an immutable snapshot retained for exactly 7 years; she has not yet added either requirement to the retirement plan.

acceptance_conditions: The legacy analytics cluster must be decommissioned.
The 48-hour read-only checksum validation must be completed before decommissioning.
Regulated records must be stored in an immutable snapshot.
The snapshot must be retained for exactly 7 years.
A commitment must preserve the enterprise customer's dashboard access through July 31 and communicate the transition.

content_checks.C3: any(c['type'] == 'checksum_validation' and c['target'] == 'legacy_analytics_cluster' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'customer_transition' and c['target'] == 'enterprise_dashboard_customer' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The 48-hour checksum requirement moves the decommission date beyond the June 30 plan and requires an explicit checksum-validation commitment before retirement.

The contract's July 31 access requirement changes the retirement date to August 1, while the audit finding changes preservation to an immutable snapshot retained for exactly 7 years and requires a customer-transition commitment.
